problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix
$S=[\begin{aligned}-8 & 4 \\ -5 & 4\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $S-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
S-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-8-\lambda  & 4 \\ -5 & 4-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(S-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(S-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-8-\lambda  & 4 \\ -5 & 4-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-8-\lambda )(4-\lambda )-4\cdot (-5) & =0 \\ -32+8\lambda -4\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}+20 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}+4\lambda -12 & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Using the quadratic formula, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\lambda  & =\frac{-4\pm \sqrt{{4}^{2}+4\cdot 1\cdot 12}}{2} \\  & =\frac{-4\pm \sqrt{64}}{2} \\  & =\frac{-4\pm 8}{2} \\  & =-6,2.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the eigenvalues are $\lambda =-6$ and $\lambda =2.$
